## Which music model fits the production workflow? {#sc-compare-music-workflow .fv-slide .sc-slide .sc-compare background-color="#ffffff"}

```{=html}
<div class="fv-meta"><span class="fv-id">S 93 / 95</span><span class="fv-cluster">LLM</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-image</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-video</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-speech</span><span class="fv-cluster active">Music</span><a class="sc-back" href="#/sc-toc">All models ↗</a></div>
<div class="sc-body cmp-body cmp-rows-5">
<p class="cmp-intro">Compare access, song length and what can be changed after generation</p>
<table class="cmp-table" aria-label="Which music model fits the production workflow?"><colgroup><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:27%"><col style="width:28%"><col style="width:25%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th scope="col">Model</th><th scope="col">Access / length</th><th scope="col">Control or editing</th><th scope="col">Operational constraint</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-music-suno-v6">Suno v6</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">Service · ≤8 min</span><span class="cmp-detail">v6 / wild / mini</span></td><td>Rewrite a section or lyric line;<br>mashups and stems.</td><td>No public API / weights found.<br>Studio: Premier only.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-music-mureka-v95">Mureka V9.5</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">Service + API</span><span class="cmp-detail">V9.5 maximum duration not found</span></td><td>Style, voice and melody refs;<br>extend, stems, remixes.</td><td>Reseller: $0.225/song.<br>Verify endpoint features.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-music-lyria-35">Lyria 3.5</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">Full songs up to 3 min</span><span class="cmp-detail">44.1 kHz stereo · Gemini API</span></td><td>Prompt-based full-song generation;<br>SynthID watermark.</td><td>Single-turn only.<br>No weights or fine-tuning.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-music-minimax-music-30">MiniMax Music 3.0</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">Open weights · ≤5 min target</span><span class="cmp-detail">32 kHz stereo WAV</span></td><td>Structured captions;<br>SGLang-Omni local serving.</td><td>Community License.<br>API closed to new users.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-music-yue-2">YuE 2</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">Open weights · 48 kHz stereo</span><span class="cmp-detail">maximum duration unspecified</span></td><td>Editable ABC melody / chords;<br>covers and local inference.</td><td>Weights: CC BY-NC 4.0;<br>code: Apache 2.0.</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p class="cmp-caveat">Duration is a limit, not a quality score. Monthly subscriptions, per-song reseller prices and local compute are different cost bases.</p>
</div>
<div class="fv-takeaway">A song service, a music API and a local score-to-audio model solve different production tasks.</div>
<div class="fv-source">Audit snapshot 18–19.10.2026 · reported results 21.10.2026 · source cards: <a href="#/sc-music-suno-v6">1</a> · <a href="#/sc-music-mureka-v95">2</a> · <a href="#/sc-music-lyria-35">3</a> · <a href="#/sc-music-minimax-music-30">4</a> · <a href="#/sc-music-yue-2">5</a> · linked cards retain original sources and conditions</div>
```

::: {.notes}
Пять моделей сравниваются по способу включения в работу. Suno предлагает длинную генерацию и редактирование внутри сервиса; Lyria — API с более коротким single-turn результатом; Mureka — API и платформенные инструменты, но не все сведения являются спецификацией exact V9.5 endpoint. MiniMax и YuE можно запускать локально с разными лицензиями и форматами. Максимальная длительность YuE не установлена: пяти­минутный пример не доказывает потолок. Не ранжируйте 48 kHz против 32 kHz как качество музыки: sample rate — формат, а не оценка исполнения.

**Evidence scope.** Comparison of the deck's supplied audit and results snapshots. No fresh model execution or current-price verification. Arithmetic and task implications are editorial derivations, not additional benchmark measurements.
